Implementation of share/zshrc.mac.zsh; it [[fb-share-zshrc-mac|serves|The share/zshrc.mac.zsh file is the concrete asset fulfilling the mac-adapted managed zshrc bead.]]. The zsh body installed to ~/.macacfs.zshrc: evaluates brew shellenv for Apple Silicon or Intel, puts ~/.local/bin first on PATH, loads Oh My Zsh with the powerlevel10k theme and the git, zsh-autosuggestions and zsh-syntax-highlighting plugins, sources ~/.p10k.zsh when present, defines modern-CLI aliases only when each tool exists (eza for ls/ll/tree, bat for cat, btop for top, nvim for vim, lazygit as lg), and initializes zoxide and atuin. The ~/.local/bin-first ordering [[fb-share-atuin-guard-impl|couples-with|The agent-safe atuin shim only intercepts atuin calls because this file puts ~/.local/bin ahead of Homebrew's bin on PATH; reordering PATH here silently bypasses the shim.]]. Before Oh My Zsh loads it prepends ${MACACFS_HOME:-$HOME/.macacfs}/share/completions to fpath, which [[fb-share-completions-impl|couples-with|compinit runs inside oh-my-zsh.sh, so the fpath line must stay above that source line or _macacfs is never autoloaded.]].
